title: Aggressive LOD on skeleton makes it look like the weights don't work since 4.4
body:
### Tested versions

4.4 - the issue
4.3 - works better

### System information

Win 11 - i5 13600kf - rtx 4070

### Issue description

Something has changed in 4.4 now when I import objects and their animations/skeleton influence look messed up from previous verions (double checked in 4.3). I found that disabling LOD in import or changing LOD on a mesh makes everything work fine but the issue is either missing LOD altogether or a really aggressive LOD changes.

Just to clarify, it's needed to tweak the LODs in 4.3 as well but the difference is pretty big compared to how aggressive it gets in 4.4. I'm not sure if this change was intended (some kind of improvement) or accidental so I'm reporting it.

Blender:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/366b2a69-a0b4-4d81-9e55-44957b7aa1e3)

This is what the default looks like in 4.3 (closer to Blender, though LOD is still at work here if adjusted more it looks the same as in Blender):

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8ce7a8f2-f53a-4c0b-8d52-eedd666236a8)

This is what the default looks like in 4.4:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/61c09da8-50e2-4cea-8928-27d89a4e3d32)

I don't know if this was an intended change in 4.4 but I'm reporting it anyway since couple people on streams already are having issues with it and think their models are broken.

### Steps to reproduce

Import a model with an armature with weight paint and just observe the difference between 4.3 and 4.4.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[MRPLodWeights.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19112707/MRPLodWeights.zip)
